sourceRefs.locator: Discussion of Witigis and Belisarius, paragraphs around notes 113–120. Surrender of Ravenna in 540 and its continued imperial control during the remaining war.

note.de: Nach Verhandlungen öffnete Ravenna Belisar die Tore. Witigis kam als Gefangener nach Konstantinopel. Ravenna blieb während des weiteren Krieges in kaiserlicher Hand.
note.en: After negotiations Ravenna opened its gates to Belisarius. Witigis was taken captive to Constantinople. Ravenna remained in imperial hands during the rest of the war.
